title: OAuth authorize_form does not validate client_id exists
description: api.rs:403-584. The GET /oauth/authorize form renders the client_id, redirect_uri, response_type, and scope from query parameters into hidden form fields. These are HTML-escaped, so XSS is prevented. However, the form renders even if the client_id is invalid or empty — the error only surfaces when the form is POST-submitted. More critically, the redirect_uri in the query is rendered into the form without verifying it matches the app's registered redirect_uri. A phishing attack could craft a URL with a malicious redirect_uri that the user sees in the form. The validation happens in authorize_submit (line 647) but after the user has already entered credentials.
